key_facts: July 22 eve-of-match update (T+1d to 1st T20I Thu July 23, 1:00 PM local / 4:30 PM IST at Harare Sports Club; sunny, 23-26C, 0% rain): UPDATED Ishan Kishan 0.19->0.17 (-0.02), Shreyas Iyer 0.16->0.17 (+0.01), held Abhishek Sharma 0.28, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi 0.19, Tilak Varma 0.09 (sum=0.90; outside=0.10: Shivam Dube ~0.040, Prabhsimran Singh ~0.028, Rinku Singh ~0.022, none/other ~0.010). Key July 22 confirmed developments: (1) Zimbabwe named their 15-man squad (Sikandar Raza c, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava, Brad Evans, Wellington Masakadza, Wessly Madhevere recalled, Newman Nyamhuri returns, Tafadzwa Tsiga debut call-up; Madande/Maposa/Musekiwa dropped) — strong new-ball bounce (Muzarabani/Ngarava) plus multiple off-spinners (Raza/Madhevere/Bennett) against India's left-hand-heavy top 7. (2) Harare pitch report (CricketAddictor/Daily Jagran): balanced surface, avg 1st innings ~158, early bounce/movement for seamers, slows for spin, large outfield rewarding strike rotation; captains prefer batting first. (3) Unanimous July 22 predicted XI: Abhishek + Sooryavanshi opening, Ishan Kishan (wk) #3, Shreyas Iyer (c) #4, Tilak Varma (vc) #5, Dube #6, Rinku #7. (4) Kishan trimmed 0.19->0.17 because Shreyas Iyer confirmed England ODI players only arrived in Harare July 21 (short 1-session prep after July 19 Lord's ODI), Indian Express noted Kishan lost touch in UK conditions (unlike Abhishek), and HT July 22 specifically flagged PBKS opener Prabhsimran Singh (439 runs @ avg 44, SR 170 in IPL 2026) as a Thursday debut candidate under PBKS skipper Iyer (~12-15% Match 1 rotation risk). (5) Iyer nudged 0.16->0.17 as confirmed starter, sole right-hander in probable top 7 vs Zim off-spin (~15% #3 float), best Indian batter in UK T20Is, and suited to Harare's large outfield. (6) Sooryavanshi held at 0.19: positive Harare mastery (175 off 80 in U19 WC final 4 months ago) + early arrival offsets Muzarabani bounce risk. Calibrated 3-match settling-hazard Monte Carlo sim outputs Abhishek 0.274-0.297, Sooryavanshi 0.181-0.195, Iyer 0.163-0.176, Kishan 0.161-0.176, Tilak 0.088-0.099.
